dominant_strengths: Clean hierarchy with subtle section labels (RECENT, ACTIONS, FILES) and disciplined left-aligned icon column for fast scanning.
Restrained dark palette with a single indigo selection state and tasteful accent hues on action icons.
Footer keyboard hints with ⌘/↵ chips signal native shortcut affordance and respect macOS command-palette conventions.
dominant_weaknesses: Highly derivative of Raycast/Linear/Cmd-K palettes; no novel mechanic, layout twist, or signature detail to call its own.
Search input lacks visible cursor state, placeholder contrast, and no result-filter feedback for the typed query 'de'.
Icon color logic feels arbitrary—green plus, blue download, yellow star, pink heart, orange clock—undermining systemic color meaning.
fix_priorities: Define a semantic icon-color system (destructive/creative/neutral) so accents communicate rather than decorate.
Strengthen query feedback: highlight matched substrings, show count, and dim non-matching items to justify the search field.
Introduce one distinctive signature—result previews, inline metadata chips, or a contextual right-pane—to escape genericism.
Tighten input affordance with a blinking caret, clearer placeholder, and breadcrumb scope to anchor user context.
rationale.norman_balance: Solid behavioral utility and decent visceral polish, but reflective resonance is thin because nothing here is memorable beyond category baseline.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes—it functions clearly as a command palette, but executes the pattern at a competent rather than distinctive level.
